title: Longest Subarray Divisible By M
statement:
Find the longest subarray (a block of consecutive elements, at least one) whose sum is divisible by `m`, and report its length. A sum of `0` is divisible by every `m`. Values can be negative. If no subarray qualifies, report `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the length of the longest subarray whose sum is divisible by `m`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= m <= 10^9`
